newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Blue-chip firms push Morocco's bourse higher.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip firms push Morocco's bourse higher.

text.p: Morocco's stock exchange closed on Thursday 0.37 percent higher with gains in ONA Group and Societe Nationale d'Investissement, stockbrokers said.
The Casablanca bourse share index closed at 636.41 points, up from 634.09 points on Wednesday.
ONA, the country's largest private holding, edged up five dirhams to 775 dirhams with 1,706 shares changing hands.
SNI, the second largest private group, rose 15 dirhams to 725 dirhams.
Steel mill Sonasid was up nine dirhams to 549 dirhams.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur closed unchanged at 580 dirhams.
Banque Commerciale du Maroc, the second largest market capitalisation, edged up two dirhams to 860 dirhams with 1,149 shares traded.
Oil refinery Samir gained 10.2 dirhams 353.25 dirhams with 2,297 shares exchanged.
Total traded volume on the official market was 16.9 million dirhams, down from 19.2 million dirhams.
On the over-the-counter market, the volume rose to 119.4 from 4.6 million dirhams.
